newsitem.title: UK: ATHLETICS-MARATHON-TRIPLE WINNER CERON OUT OF LONDON MARATHON.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-MARATHON-TRIPLE WINNER CERON OUT OF LONDON MARATHON.

text.p: Dionicio Ceron, winner of the London Marathon for the past three years, said on Thursday he would not run in this year's race.

"London has become very special to me, but after being champion for three years I recognise it is now time for me to have a look at my race career and tackle new events," the Mexican athlete said in a statement.
Ceron was the first three-time winner of the marathon through London's city centre and organisers, who issued his statement, said they hoped he would take part in future races.
Nearly 40,000 people will take part in the marathon which will be held on April 13.
